register_env_passthrough: register environment variable names as allowed to pass through to sandboxed execution environments
is_env_passthrough: check whether a given environment variable name is allowed to pass through to sandboxes
get_all_passthrough: get the union of skill-registered and config-based environment variable passthrough names
clear_env_passthrough: clear the skill-scoped environment variable passthrough allowlist for a session
load_config_passthrough: load the env_passthrough allowlist from config.yaml and cache it for the process
